summary: Add a common fixture setup and native ask packet with retained creation, no-read-mutation and client-local evidence.

replay.detail: The tooling does not replay or initialize a store.

schema.detail: Use existing native work ask and attention/claim reads without new claims.

rules.detail: The existing CLI enforces actor authority; seed text and exact fixture operator socket are additionally validated.

compatibility.detail: No normal instance, client or protocol behavior changes.

downtime.detail: Shipping source does not start or restart a service.

manual.detail: Setup, Fabric lifecycle, enrollment and grants require separate authorization. An immutable manifest and separate run record bind every journey to the same ask and enrolled device. E1 creation provenance, E2 no-read-mutation and E3 three-class local diffs establish initially unseen and unmutated evidence; native asks have no stored unread bit. Fixture service uninstall retains evidence; deleting state is not authorized.

recovery.detail: The check is read-only and refused socket/text inputs have no effects.
